name: Empire State Building
use: Evaluation only (sb.benchmark_massing): a building's documented form to score a massing against. Nothing builds geometry from this file.

sources.supports: footprint 424 x 187 ft; 5-storey base over the whole lot; 60 ft setback on all sides above the 5th storey; setbacks at the 21st, 25th, 30th, 72nd, 81st and 85th storeys; 102 storeys; roof 1,250 ft at the 102nd floor; top floor 1,224 ft; antenna tip 1,454 ft; mast 158 ft above the 86th floor in four rectangular tiers, a cylindrical shaft and a conical pinnacle
setback floors 21, 25, 30, 72, 81, 85; 60 ft setback above the 5th storey; setbacks at the tops of elevator shafts (interiors at most 28 ft deep)

National Register nomination, its description taken from the NYC Landmarks Preservation Commission designation report LP-2000 (1981): setbacks at the 21st, 25th, 30th and 72nd floors, a pronounced one at the 81st, a final one at the 85th; 1,250 ft, 102 storeys (scanned PDF: read through search summaries, not directly)

storey_m.method: roof_m / storeys (1,250 ft / 102): no floor-to-floor height is documented in these sources

setback_heights_m.method: setback floor x storey_m; the base's storeys are taller than average, so its estimate runs low

tolerance_m.method: 2 average storeys: the per-floor heights are not documented
